title: Over 1,100 minors reprimanded for curfew violations in Tacloban

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — More than 1,100 minors were reprimanded for violating curfew hours in Tacloban City from Nov. 9 to 15, making this the most frequently recorded violation during the weeklong enforcement of the government’s Safer Cities initiative. The Tacloban City Police Office (TCPO) reported that 1,123 minors were reprimanded for curfew violations during the period, followed by 929 individuals caught smoking in public places and 891 reprimanded for drinking alcoholic beverages in public areas. The police also recorded 632 individuals reprimanded for roaming public places without shirts, while 269 were warned for using karaoke machines beyond the allowable hours. READ: […]...
